name: color-is-box
description: Zero-dependency 3D RGB/HSB/OKLCH color picker — Web Component + JS API

scripts.dev: node -e "import('http').then(({createServer}) => import('fs').then(({readFileSync, existsSync}) => import('path').then(({join, extname}) => createServer((req, res) => { const p = req.url === '/' ? '/demo/index.html' : req.url; const f = join(process.cwd(), p); if (!existsSync(f)) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not Found'); } const m = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.css': 'text/css' }; res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': m[extname(f)] || 'application/octet-stream' }); res.end(readFileSync(f)); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Server running: http://localhost:3000/demo/index.html')))))"
